name: Affinity Business First Visa Credit Card

localized_names.en: Affinity Business First Visa Credit Card

credit_required.notes: Affinity membership required ($5 membership eligibility account).

base_rate.description: 1 point per $1 spent; up to 6x bonus points when shopping through the rewards website.

rewards.redemption_notes: Points never expire and redeem for travel, cash back, gift cards and merchandise.

signup_bonus.description: 5,000 bonus points after the first purchase on the account.

notes: APR and foreign transaction fee are not stated on the product page, so they are null. No Visa network package is stated, so network_tier is none.
